xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3162: GitLab-side merges are never observed: MIN-898 merged 3.5h ago still shows as awaiting merge and hangs in 'merging'

plan.title: Observe GitLab-side merges and reconcile Overdeck merge state
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Nothing observes forge-side merge state for non-GitHub projects: verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle hard-refuses non-GitHub issues, the deacon's stale-merge reconciler gates on isGitHub, the merging/verifying states have no runtime time bound, and the polyrepo merge-click path re-merges repos already recorded as merged. A GitLab merge — by the pipeline, another actor, or a human in the GitLab UI — leaves review_status and merge_set_repos untouched, so merged work stays on Awaiting Merge, merge clicks hang or fail opaquely, and UAT generations pick up already-merged members. Live verification on 2026-07-26 showed MIN-898 and MIN-858 are partially merged (fe MRs merged on GitLab, api/docs MRs still open), which a correct reconciler must record without terminalizing.
narratives.Proposal: Make the forge the merge oracle for every forge type through the existing merge-completeness door: (WI-1) per-repo forge refresh + writeback in merge-completeness.ts; (WI-2) a forge-aware branch in the deacon's stale-merge reconciler that terminalizes only on complete-with-positive-evidence; (WI-3) a 30-minute bound on merging/verifying that reconciles against the forge then resets to pending; (WI-4) non-GitHub support in verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle; (WI-5) merge-click path skips forge-merged repos and self-heals fully-merged issues through the existing no-changed-repos success path; (WI-6) propagation proof (eligibility → ready set → generation invalidation) plus the live MIN-898/MIN-858 recovery checkpoint; (WI-7) docs. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-3162.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- GitLab webhook ingress of any kind
- GitLab closed-without-merge MR reconciliation (reconcileClosedPrReadyForMerge keeps its GitHub-only scope)
- Changes to how merges execute (per-repo MR flow, quality gates, rebase)
- Auto-retry of failed repo merges (MIN-898/MIN-858 api/docs retries stay operator/strike-driven through the normal Merge path)
- Any change to GitHub-project behavior
- Manual DB/record backfill for MIN-898/MIN-858 (recovery flows through the deployed reconciler and the normal merge path)

autoDecisions.summary: Poll via deacon patrol through assessMergeCompleteness instead of adding GitLab webhook ingress or new forge adapter methods
autoDecisions.rationale: GitHub's pull_request webhook (webhook-handlers.ts:407-438) has no GitLab counterpart, every other drift reconciliation in this family is a deacon patrol, and merge-completeness.ts is already the forge-aware, polyrepo-aware door used by requireCompletePolyrepoMerge — one read door, no parallel mechanism.

autoDecisions.summary: Bound stuck merging/verifying at 30 minutes, not the issue's 'a few minutes'
autoDecisions.rationale: Polyrepo verification gates legitimately run docker builds for 10-20 minutes inside the verifying window; 30 minutes mirrors the conservatism of existing stuck-state constants (STUCK_ASSEMBLING_MS is 60 min) while still bounding the state.

autoDecisions.summary: Restrict forge polling to merge-relevant issues (readyForMerge, merging/verifying/queued/failed, merge-set merging/failed)
autoDecisions.rationale: Bounds git-fetch and glab API cost per tick across MYN's 6 repos; mid-pipeline issues are where drift does not hurt and they enter the scoped set as soon as they reach a merge-relevant state.

autoDecisions.summary: Terminalize only on complete completeness plus at least one artifact-backed 'merged' repo verdict
autoDecisions.rationale: Branch absence or zero-ahead ('no-changes') is not proof of merge — the existing GitHub reconciler makes the same call at deacon-merge.ts:185-189; positive evidence prevents premature post-merge lifecycle (agent pause, Docker cleanup, close-out).

autoDecisions.summary: Ready-set and generation exclusion is propagation through existing eligibility/isStale machinery, not new train-side filtering
autoDecisions.rationale: mergeStatus=merged already makes an issue ineligible (review-status.ts:60) and isStale() already invalidates generations whose member left the ready queue (uat-reconciler.ts:149-164); adding forge polling to the train would duplicate the door and cost glab calls per candidate per tick.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not terminalize MIN-898/MIN-858 despite the issue text's fix direction 4
autoDecisions.rationale: Live forge + SQLite evidence (2026-07-26 ~21:00 UTC) shows both are only partially merged (fe MRs merged; api/docs MRs still open); terminalizing them would strand unmerged api/docs work. Correct recovery is per-repo truth writeback plus a self-healing retry of the genuinely unmerged repos.

items.title: Per-repo forge refresh and writeback in merge-completeness

expected_outputs: merge-completeness suites pass including new forge-refresh cases
metadata.parallelSafeReason: wave-0 foundation: touches only merge-completeness.ts and its two test files, which no other plan item modifies; every dependent item sits behind a blocks edge

narrative.Action: Extend src/lib/cloister/merge-completeness.ts into the single forge-observation door. (1) Add exported observeForgeMergeState(issueId, labels?): resolve repos via the existing resolveRepos(), run the existing assessRepoMergeCompleteness per repo, and for every repo whose verdict is 'merged' while its merge-set row says otherwise, write merge_status:'merged' plus the discovered artifactUrl through withRepoStateSync/upsertMergeSetSync (the existing merge-set write door in src/lib/merge-set.ts); return { complete, hasPositiveMergedEvidence, repos, mergeSet }. (2) Export hasPositiveMergedEvidence = repos.some(r => r.state === 'merged') semantics for reuse by WI-2/WI-4. (3) Extend reconcileStrandedRepos with a second pass: required, non-skipped repos that already have artifactUrl but sit at pending/failed/merging get a findMergedArtifact check and flip to 'merged' on positive evidence (today it only backfills missing artifact URLs). Fail open on any forge/git error (NFR-2). See PRD WI-1 in .pan/drafts/PAN-3162.md.

items.title: observeForgeMergeState returns complete=true with hasPositiveMergedEvidence=true and persists merge_status='merged' + artifactUrl to merge_set_repos when assessRepoMergeCompleteness reports a merged artifact the row lacks
observeForgeMergeState writes nothing when every repo verdict is unmerged, no-changes, or unverifiable, and hasPositiveMergedEvidence is false for an all-no-changes result
reconcileStrandedRepos flips a required repo row from failed (or pending/merging) with an existing artifactUrl to merged when findMergedArtifact proves the merge, and leaves it untouched otherwise
a forge error inside either function surfaces as an unverifiable blocker reason and produces no merge-set writes (fail-open), covered in merge-completeness-forge-error.test.ts
Forge-aware branch in the deacon stale-merge reconciler

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/deacon-merge.ts extend reconcileStaleMergeStatus(): keep the GitHub check at lines 209-227 untouched, and when resolveGitHubIssueSync(issueId).isGitHub is false (or the issue has a polyrepo merge set with non-GitHub repos) AND the issue is in the merge-relevant scope guard (readyForMerge true, or merge_status in merging/verifying/queued/failed, or merge-set status merging/failed), call WI-1's observeForgeMergeState. On complete && hasPositiveMergedEvidence, apply the same terminalization the GitHub path applies at lines 249-257 (setReviewStatusSync({ mergeStatus:'merged', mergeStep:'post-merge-cleanup', readyForMerge:false }) + enqueuePostMergeLifecycle) behind the same re-planning deferral (active planning agent or spec draft/proposed, PAN-1994) and closed-out spec guard (completed/cancelled, PAN-1190). Partial completeness writes per-repo truth (via observeForgeMergeState) but never terminalizes. Unverifiable skips the tick with a warning log. Patrol registration in deacon.ts is unchanged (reconcileStaleMergeStatus is already wired at deacon.ts:3053-3056). See PRD WI-2.

items.title: on the patrol tick the reconciler marks a forge-complete non-GitHub issue mergeStatus='merged' with mergeStep='post-merge-cleanup' and readyForMerge=false, and spawns the post-merge lifecycle enqueue
a partially merged issue preserves its non-terminal mergeStatus while the patrol updates the merged repo's merge-set row from the forge
the reconciler defers terminalization when a planning agent is running or the spec is draft/proposed, and skips issues whose spec is completed/cancelled
issues outside the merge-relevant scope guard are not polled (no observeForgeMergeState call), and an unverifiable verdict produces a warning log and no status writes
GitHub-project issues follow the pre-existing path byte-identically: the existing deacon-merge test suite passes unmodified
30-minute bound on merging/verifying with forge reconciliation

expected_outputs: stuck-merging suite passes with fake timers

narrative.Action: Add reconcileStuckMergingStates() to src/lib/cloister/deacon-merge.ts and wire it into the deacon tick next to reconcileStaleMergeStatus (src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts:3053-3056). For each review row with merge_status 'merging' or 'verifying' whose latest {type:'merge'} history entry (fallback updated_at) is older than STUCK_MERGING_MS = 30*60*1000: reconcile against the forge (WI-1's observeForgeMergeState for non-GitHub; factor the existing GitHub PR check so this patrol and the stale-merge reconciler share it rather than duplicating gh pr list inline). If complete with positive evidence, terminalize per WI-2. Otherwise setReviewStatusSync back to mergeStatus:'pending' with mergeNotes explaining the reset, preserving readyForMerge only when review+test+verification gates pass — the same gate check clearStuckMergeStatuses uses at src/lib/review-status.ts:708-712. Tests must use vi.useFakeTimers(); never real timeouts (repo rule). See PRD WI-3.

a merging row older than 30 minutes with no forge merge resets to pending with an explanatory mergeNotes, preserving readyForMerge when review+test+verification gates pass and dropping it otherwise
the verifying state is covered by the same bound, and an unverifiable forge verdict produces no status write
Non-GitHub support in verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle

expected_outputs: merge-verification suites pass including non-GitHub cases

narrative.Action: Replace the hard refusal at src/lib/cloister/merge-verification.ts:210-213 ('Non-GitHub project ... cannot be auto-verified') with a read-only call through the WI-1 door: run assessMergeCompleteness(issueId) (no writeback in this path — it is a pure read for callers) and return merged:true only when complete AND at least one repo verdict is 'merged'; otherwise merged:false with the completeness summary as the reason; on error return merged:false fail-open. Keep the verifiedMergedRepos/verifiedMergedRef fast paths and the entire GitHub branch untouched. This unblinds shouldSkipDispatchAsMerged (merge-verification.ts:297) for MYN, which is consulted by review-agent.ts:332, deacon-review-status.ts:674, and service-reactive.ts:240. See PRD WI-4.

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts change the activeRepos filter (lines 533-535) to also exclude repo.mergeStatus === 'merged'. The forge refresh itself happens one call earlier: reconcileStrandedRepos (line 517) gains WI-1's second pass, so pending/failed repo rows that the forge proves merged are flipped before the filter runs. A fully-merged issue then falls into the existing activeRepos.length === 0 success path (lines 537-551) which terminalizes the issue and runs postMergeLifecycle — reuse that path as-is; verify its status writes and lifecycle call fire for this entry. If no merge-ops route test file exists yet, create src/dashboard/server/routes/__tests__/merge-ops.test.ts following the style of the neighboring route suites. See PRD WI-5.

Ready-set propagation proof and MIN-898/MIN-858 recovery checkpoint

expected_outputs: live checkpoint (or dry-run fallback) recorded in the task notes

narrative.Action: Two parts. (1) Pin the propagation chain with regression tests: an issue whose review row is mergeStatus='merged' is excluded by listEligibleCandidatesByProject() via mergeGateEligibility (extend tests/unit/lib/flywheel-merge-order.test.ts), and isStale() reports a generation member that left the desired set as 'left the ready queue' (extend the uat-reconciler suite if not already covered — check tests/unit/lib/cloister/ for the existing file name first). (2) Live implementation checkpoint after deploy: observe one deacon tick reconciling MIN-898 and MIN-858 — their fe repo rows confirmed merged from the forge, the issues NOT terminalized (api/docs MRs still open), and no patrol errors in the dashboard log; then hand the api/docs retry for both to the operator or a strike through the normal Merge path, which WI-5 now makes skip the merged fe repo. Fallback if the live checkpoint cannot run in-session: dry-run the reconciler function against both issue ids from a workspace shell and record the output plus the unit tests. See PRD 'Live-state recovery' section.

items.title: a regression test shows listEligibleCandidatesByProject excludes an issue whose mergeStatus is 'merged'
a regression test shows isStale marks a generation stale when a member leaves the ready set
the checkpoint records that MIN-898 and MIN-858 are reconciled (fe truth confirmed) without being terminalized, with dashboard-log or dry-run evidence captured in the task notes
Document the forge-neutral merge oracle and new patrols

expected_outputs: lint passes; the three docs render the new oracle/patrol behavior

narrative.Action: Update three docs to match the new behavior. docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md: rewrite the 'Single Merge Oracle' section (currently lines 144-156) — the oracle is now the forge adapter's merged review artifact per repo (GitHub PR or GitLab MR) with completeness across required repos and positive-evidence terminalization; delete the sentence 'For non-GitHub projects … the operator confirms manually'; document the 30-minute merging/verifying bound and the skip-merged-repos click behavior. docs/RECOVERY-NET.md: add the forge-merge reconciler and the stuck-merging patrol to the patrol inventory with cadence and fail-open semantics. docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md: one paragraph stating forge-observed merges leave the ready set via eligibility and invalidate live generations through isStale(), with no train-side polling by design. See PRD WI-7.
